# Pixel Crawler (Free Pack) by Anokolisa

Source: https://anokolisa.itch.io/free-pixel-art-asset-pack-topdown-tileset-rpg-16x16-sprites
License: free for commercial & non-commercial use, no attribution required, cannot resell
raw/modified asset files as a competing product. See LICENSE terms fetched from the
author's linked Google Drive doc (summarized in project notes).

Files used (copied to public/assets/, prefixed pc-):
- Dungeon_Tiles.png -> pc-dungeon-tiles.png (wall + floor crops)
- Resources.png -> pc-resources.png (barrel prop)
- Dungeon_Props.png -> pc-dungeon-props.png (banners, tombstone)
- Knight NPC (Idle/Run/Death) -> pc-knight-*.png (hero)
- Orc (Idle/Run/Death) -> pc-orc-*.png (fast/weak enemy, "imp" role)
- Skeleton - Warrior (Idle/Run/Death) -> pc-skeleton-*.png (tankier enemy)

The 0x72 DungeonTilesetII pack is still used for the HUD heart icons.
The chest sprite is hand-drawn procedurally (no matching chest found in this pack).
